items.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 cinematic gallery cover for a cross-film visual reference collection named 'Library — Scene and Space'. Create one original, richly detailed wide film still of an architecturally distinctive library interior, not a collage. Deep repeating rows of dark timber bookshelves and reading tables recede to a clear vanishing point; tall side windows cast layered cool daylight and soft reverse light through a little dust; a few warm brass practical task lamps add restrained amber pools; one small human reader gives scale. Carefully composed architectural depth, realistic tactile books, sophisticated green, aged-gold, warm brown and silver-gray grade, natural film grain, subtle tension and contemplative quiet. Avoid copying any recognizable movie frame, celebrity, logo, printed title, watermark, split screen, contact sheet, diagram, or embedded text. Full-bleed landscape image.

Warm practical bulbs ripple across the wet floor; their partial reflections create a tender frame within a frame. Human-scale Asian urban cinema, restrained amber and olive, tactile wood and glass, no ceremony. Apply layered reflection. Hard silver-grain contrast, a narrow side beam and spare geometric shadows create Japanese avant-garde tension within one tactile scene. Apply low-key lighting. items.prompt: Create one original 16:9 landscape cinematic cover image. At sunset on an invented frontier plain, a horse and rider rush across a telephoto-compressed corridor of dust while a second figure remains far behind. One suspended instant of grit, heat and motion carries the energy of multi-speed action without multiple frames. Brutal orange sunlight, charcoal shadow and high-contrast haze make a tragic western elegy. Apply high-contrast lighting. Palette accents drawn from #d0661c, #e0761a, #d8a830, #6e91c0; preserve the scene's natural color logic. One coherent frame, no panels or collage, no typography, letters, logo, watermark, recognizable celebrity, or recreation of an existing movie still.
